title: Text recognition (OCR)
intro: Text recognition runs locally inside Bauplan with Tesseract.js. Documents and extracted text are not sent to an OCR service. Extracted business fields use fixed rules and must be reviewed.
requestFailed: The OCR settings or language models could not be loaded. Try again.
legacySettings: Previous service settings are no longer used. OCR now runs locally; save these settings to remove the old service configuration.
modelsHelp: Models are downloaded only when you choose Download. They are stored with the app data and used offline afterward.
formats: Supported input: PDF, PNG, JPEG, TIFF and BMP.
noSearchablePdf: Searchable PDF output is not supported.
limits: Maximum 25 MiB, 10 PDF pages, 180 seconds and two concurrent recognition jobs. PDFs use embedded text where available; pages without usable text are rendered locally and OCRed. OCR text is not stored. Field extraction uses German-focused rules.
testSuccess: The synthetic test image was successfully read. Draft settings were not saved.
resetConfirm: Delete saved OCR settings and disable text recognition?
unreadable: The document could not be read.
unsupported: Unsupported document format or mismatched file contents. Use PDF, PNG, JPEG, TIFF or BMP.
tooManyPages: The PDF exceeds 10 pages. Split it before recognition.
invalidPdf: The PDF is unreadable, corrupt or encrypted.
busy: OCR is busy. Please try again later.
timeout: Text recognition exceeded the time limit.
modelMissing: Download the selected language model before enabling or testing OCR.
modelDownloadFailed: The language model could not be downloaded or validated. Check the app's network access and try again.
modelInUse: This language model is used by the active OCR settings. Choose another language or disable OCR before removing it.
processingFailed: The local OCR operation failed. Check the app logs and try again.
partial: Recognition was incomplete. No partial result was applied.
testFailed: The local OCR engine responded, but the expected text was not recognized in the test image.
